changeSet.author: mherman22
changeSet.comment: Add FREEZER_OFFLINE to alert_type CHECK constraint so an unresponsive device can raise its own alert. The constraint is redeclared wholesale by every changeset that touches it, so this list preserves the existing alert types and adds FREEZER_OFFLINE. The "must be last" invariant has moved to 092, which redeclares the constraint again to add FREEZER_HUMIDITY - no changeset anywhere in base-changelog.xml may redeclare chk_alert_type after 092, including the analyzer/ and qc/ changelogs, which base-changelog.xml includes after 3.5.x.x/base.xml.

changeSet.comment: Add per-freezer register_count/word_order and RS-485 driver-timing config for devices with non-default Modbus decoding (issue #3743).

changeSet.author: mherman22

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_name = 'uk_freezer_reading_freezer_recorded_at' AND table_name = 'freezer_reading'

changeSet.comment: Deduplicate existing rows and add a unique constraint on (freezer_id, recorded_at) so a retried poll can't insert a duplicate reading.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.freezer_reading fr USING clinlims.freezer_reading fr2 WHERE fr.freezer_id = fr2.freezer_id AND fr.recorded_at = fr2.recorded_at AND fr.id > fr2.id;

changeSet.author: mherman22

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'freezer' AND column_name = 'temperature_offset' AND numeric_precision IS NULL

changeSet.comment: Give the hand-entered freezer and threshold_profile DECIMAL columns explicit precision/scale. Do not add freezer_reading's measured columns: a ceiling there fails this ALTER on an existing out-of-range row and then makes each later poll of that device roll back unstored, starving the FREEZER_OFFLINE detector.

changeSet.author: mherman22

and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'clinlims' AND indexname = 'idx_freezer_name_active'

changeSet.comment: Replace freezer.name's unconditional unique constraint with a partial index scoped to deleted=false so a soft-deleted name can be reused (issue #3904).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.freezer DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS freezer_name_key;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_freezer_name_active ON clinlims.freezer (name) WHERE deleted = false;

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS clinlims.idx_freezer_name_active; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_freezer_name ON clinlims.freezer (name);
